_help: Edit this file to change the lists. 'levels' is the main list, 'challenges' is the challenge list. Order = rank: the first entry is #1.

estimate: true makes an entry unranked (#-). It stays where you put it as a difficulty reference, gives no points, takes no records and doesn't shift the ranks of other entries. Its 'id' is the vanilla (RobTop server) level ID; other entries use the GDPS ID.
difficulty: easy | medium | hard | insane | extreme
length: tiny | short | medium | long | xl
gamemodes: cube | ship | ball | ufo | wave | robot
skillsets: see 'allowedSkillsets' in settings; add your own there
records: percent 100 = completion. Progress records need percent >= the level's 'requirement'.
video: any URL (YouTube etc.) or null. id: the in-game level ID or null.
points: #1 gets settings.points.top; each rank below multiplies by settings.points.decay.
challengePoints (optional, in settings): same as 'points' but for the challenge list. Left out = uses 'points'.
